evidence: Users on 192.168.210.0/24 cannot reach the web server at 10.50.0.10 on TCP 80.
Topology indicates users connect through R20 to the web server.
R20 show access-lists output shows Extended IP access list WEB-FILTER with statement 10 deny tcp 192.168.210.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.50.0.10 eq 80.
R20 show running-config interface Gi0/0 output shows ip access-group WEB-FILTER in.
root_cause: Extended access list WEB-FILTER on R20 explicitly denies TCP port 80 traffic from 192.168.210.0/24 to web server 10.50.0.10 inbound on interface Gi0/0.
verification: Run show access-lists on R20 and confirm the permit statement precedes the deny statement for TCP port 80.
Manually test user connectivity to the web server on TCP 80 after the approved change.
fix_steps: Review the existing access list WEB-FILTER entries and interface Gi0/0 configuration on R20.
Modify the WEB-FILTER access list to permit TCP traffic on port 80 from 192.168.210.0/24 to host 10.50.0.10 before the deny statement.
Verify the updated access list rules and interface application.
Test TCP port 80 connectivity from the 192.168.210.0/24 network to the web server at 10.50.0.10.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: Extended ACL WEB-FILTER explicitly denies TCP port 80 traffic to 10.50.0.10.
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Modify ACL WEB-FILTER to permit TCP port 80 traffic to web server 10.50.0.10.
